# Archived GitHub Classroom configuration

`autograding.json` is retained only as a compatibility/reference artifact for the historical GitHub Classroom format. GitHub Classroom was decommissioned on 28 August 2026; this file is not an active assignment configuration and must not be presented as an available workflow.

For new Week 1 assignments, use Classroom 50. Import `week1/classroom50-tests.json` in the Classroom 50 assignment and place teacher-side tests from `week1/classroom50-autograder/` in the course organization's private Classroom 50 bundle, as described in `docs/week1-framework.md` and `instructions.txt`.
